context: On-demand B2B2C / P2P Logistics platform inspired by Uber for deliveries with 4 distinct roles (Loja, Motoboy, Administrador, Cliente Final)

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border, rounded-xl, no heavy shadows except hover lift
surface_strategies.header: Crystal glass with backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-white/15 fixed z-50
surface_strategies.modals: Opaque surface with backdrop blur overlay

key_functionalities: Role switcher for testing all 4 profiles (Loja, Motoboy, Admin, Cliente)
Automatic pricing calculator based on distance table (0.5km to 15km)
Batch delivery support up to 3 simultaneous orders
Weekly billing and statement closure (Sundays to Tuesdays)
Real-time chat and support tickets system
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement top-bar persistent Role Switcher with buttons for Loja, Motoboy, Administrador, and Cliente Final.
Build fully interactive dashboards for all 4 roles using Shadcn components and Tailwind CSS.
Create dynamic distance-based pricing calculator in Cliente/Loja view (0.5km to 15km tier table).
Implement batch delivery management (up to 3 simultaneous orders in a batch for Motoboy).
Implement Motoboy Online/Offline toggle with instant status change and order radar simulation.
Implement weekly financial statement closure view (Sundays to Tuesdays) with payout settlement for Admin and Motoboy.
Build real-time chat modal and support ticketing center accessible from all roles.
Build Google Maps integrated simulation view with animated delivery markers and route simulation.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes and high contrast accessibility standards.
universal_guidelines: Never use full-page generic centering or universal transitions.
Apply generous padding and modern card structures.
Ensure complete role isolation while allowing instant role switching for testing.
